newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from the official homepage, embedded demo form, Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. The form offers national and genre channels including Drum N Bass, Dubstep, Afro House, Afrobeats, Amapiano, Dance, Future House, Tech House, Techno, Trance, Trap and Tropical. The site states that it is worldwide, searches for talent continuously, has 45 million YouTube subscribers in 2026 and has curated more than 7,000 releases. The terms require ownership or authorization for all submitted music, do not guarantee a feature and allow selected tracks to be featured with credit. The privacy policy states that demo details may be used for review and potential collaboration and retained for up to two years unless deletion is requested. contact@7clouds.org is first-party, syntactically valid and domain-aligned, but it is a general/privacy contact rather than the canonical demo route. No field, checkbox, link, account, CAPTCHA, payment or submission was used.

newPlatforms.country: Brazil / São Paulo-based global Drum & Bass and Bass Music ecosystem.
newPlatforms.submissionMethod: Official DNBB website linking to the external DNBB LabelRadar portal and publishing file, filename, biography, social and private-link guidelines.
newPlatforms.feeAmount: Five LabelRadar credits are required for a direct label submission. The Lite plan provides five free credits monthly; additional credits and PRO are optional paid products.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: LabelRadar login and credit balance, correct DNBB imprint and genre fit, file preparation, BPM/key/title metadata, biography and socials, private-link access, rights, Content ID, AI policy, privacy, hidden verification, post-selection terms and final submission require human review.
newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from DNBB Music Group's official website and the officially linked LabelRadar route. DNBB describes a global ecosystem built around Drum & Bass and Bass Music, reports 12 active labels, more than 1,400 releases and streaming in 180 countries, and publishes genres including DnB, Jungle, Dubstep, Breakbeat, UK Garage, Bass House, House, Techno and Trance. Its submission guidelines ask for WAV 24-bit or MP3 320 kbps, BPM/key/title in the filename, a short biography plus social links and a private SoundCloud or Dropbox link. The site reports more than 120 demos in the current month, eight signings in 2026 and a 14-day average response. dnbbrecords@dnbb.com.br and suporte@dnbb.com.br are first-party, syntactically valid and domain-aligned business contacts, but the official demo call routes submissions to LabelRadar. LabelRadar requires an artist account and five credits for a direct label submission; the Lite plan supplies five free monthly credits while extra credits and PRO are optional. No account, credit, upload, link, email, CAPTCHA, payment or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from Reggae Global Radio's official submission, homepage, shows and site-terms pages. The canonical route is music@reggaeglobalradio.com. New, upcoming and inspiring artists must include a biography. MP3 tracks must be labeled Artist Name - Title of Song; WAV files are not accepted. The sender must identify released or pre-release status, provide two correctly named Reggae Global Radio station-ID jingles and place all required material in one email. The official site is marked © 2026, publishes an active programme roster and positions the station as a worldwide reggae hub.
